name: 讲解传授（Teach）
description_zh: 把一段工作用大白话讲清楚，让人真正理解。串联 how 与 why 两个技能的产出，编织成一份统一、易懂的讲解。用于「教我这个」「帮我真正理解 X」「给我讲讲这个改动或子系统」。
description_en: Explain a body of work plainly so a person actually understands it. Runs the `how` and `why` skills and weaves what they find into one clear explanation. Use for 'teach me this', 'help me really understand X', 'explain this change or subsystem to me'.
